sources.title: Niue Public Service Commission, Public Service Official Circular: Public Holidays for festive season 2025/2026 (4 December 2025)
sources.said: 25th December 2025 (Thursday) Public Holiday – Christmas Day 26th December 2025 (Friday) Public Holiday – Boxing Day 1st January 2026 (Thursday) Public Holiday - New Year’s Day 2nd January 2026 (Friday) Public Service Holiday

sources.title: Niue Public Service Commission, Official Public Service Circular: Public Holiday – State Funeral for the late former Premier, Hon. Sani Elia Lakatani (28 January 2026)
sources.said: The Niue Public Service Commission formally advises all public servants that Friday, 30th of January 2026, is to be observed as a Public Holiday in honour of the Late Former Premier of Niue, Hon. Sani Elia Lakatani.

sources.title: Niue Public Service Commission, circular on Easter 2026 (30 March 2026)
sources.said: The Niue Public Service Commission would like to notify the whole Public Service, that the following days will be observed as Public Holidays for Easter 2026. 3 April 2026 (Friday) Good Friday 6 April 2026 (Monday) Easter Monday

sources.title: Niue Public Service Commission, Official Public Service Circular: Public Holidays for April 2025 (7 April 2025; read as scanned)
sources.said: The Public Service Commission would like to remind all public servants that the following days will be observed as Public Holidays in respect of Good Friday, Easter Monday and ANZAC Day. … FRIDAY 18TH APRIL – GOOD FRIDAY MONDAY 21ST APRIL – EASTER MONDAY (Reopen on Tuesday 22nd) FRIDAY 25TH APRIL – ANZAC DAY

sources.title: Niue Public Service Commission, Official Public Service Circular: Public Holiday – Observance of the Official Birthday of His Majesty King Charles III (26 May 2026)
sources.said: The Public Service Commission hereby notifies all public servants that Monday, 1 June 2026 will be observed as a public holiday in honour of the Official Birthday of His Majesty King Charles III, Sovereign and Head of State of Niue.

sources.title: Niue Public Service Commission, Public Service Official Circular: Public Holidays for the month of October 2026 (29 September 2026)
sources.said: The Commission would like to notify the Public Service, the following days will be observed as Public Holidays in Commemoration of the Constitution Celebrations and Peniamina Celebration Day 2026. DATE HOLIDAY 19 October 2026 (Monday) Flag Raising Day 20 October 2026 (Tuesday) Pule Fakamotu 26 October 2026 (Monday) Peniamina Celebration Day
